However, the company remains solidly profitable with $24.5B in revenue, an 11% operating margin ($2.58B), and positive net income of $1.79B, supported by a healthy retained earnings base of $20.2B. This combination of strong profitability and market presence alongside high leverage and moderate liquidity profile is characteristic of a solid, investment-grade issuer in the triple-B range.

DECISION: BBB
